name: Corpuscle
description: Red-cell shapes: round outside, dished in the middle.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: @repeat(4, @rand(40%, 60%)) / @repeat(4, @rand(40%, 60%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 32%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: @repeat(4, @rand(34%, 66%)) / @repeat(4, @rand(34%, 66%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
